status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive as the emergency third quarterback for Monday night's game against the Broncos.
status.longComment: Nussmeier will be the reserve option behind Patrick Mahomes and Justin Fields. The seventh-round rookie out of LSU will only be able to play if both Mahomes and Fields exit the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: McDonald (knee) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Broncos.
status.longComment: McDonald made one tackle before exiting the game. The second-year player out of TCU is a rotational edge rusher on the Chiefs' defense, and his absence will likely mean more supplemental pass rushes from R Mason Thomas.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Delane (shoulder) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday night's game against the Broncos.
status.longComment: Delane started his NFL debut by intercepting Bo Nix on the Broncos' opening possession. The cornerback's injury may be a flare-up of an existing issue he struggled with throughout OTAs. With the first-round rookie ruled out, Nohl Williams will likely see more snaps at outside cornerback.
